propositions: bridge_fsck reads prev_snapshot.json as an offline Jira oracle and uses field values for drift classification, so narrowing prev to a key-set would silently degrade classification accuracy
bridge_fsck is an out-of-band consumer of the snapshot file that loads it directly rather than via ctx.prev_snapshot, making it undetectable by tests that exercise reconcile_once

When prev_snapshot contains empty dict entries {jira_key: {}}, field-based classification fails but membership checks still work, requiring explicit handling to report indeterminate rather than false drift
bridge_fsck must classify on membership alone where field values are not required, and report indeterminate status for cases genuinely requiring field values

Against key-set prev fixtures, bridge_fsck drift classification must be identical to full-payload fixtures for membership-only cases and report indeterminate for field-dependent cases, with unchanged CLI exit codes and JSON output shape
